title: Talking with Latter-day Saints
tagline: Their claims about the Book of Mormon, the apostasy, Joseph Smith and deification, read in their own essays.
whyItMatters: Latter-day Saints are known for family and service, and they often welcome serious conversation. Reading their own essays lets you speak about God and Christ without caricature.

mindset.tip: Respect the person: Latter-day Saints are neighbours of great sincerity. Give your reasons with gentleness and respect. (1 Peter 3:15-16; Lumen Gentium 16)
Read the Church's own Gospel Topics essays; they are candid, and quoting them shows you did your homework.
Ask what they mean by "God", "Christian" and "salvation"; the same words often carry different meanings.
Keep to one question, such as who God is or where authority lies, rather than a list of historical embarrassments.
Know that the Church does not recognise LDS baptism as valid, but does not judge persons. (CCC 1256)
